english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for an animal or human foot, and it also means the base of something in phrases such as 樓梯腳.

exampleSentences.english: I hurt my foot on the table.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 bei2 zoeng1 toi2 zing2 can1 laa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an animal limb or an object support, and is also common for a person's leg in casual speech.

exampleSentences.english: The dog has hurt its leg.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gau2 gau2 zek3 goek3 zing2 can1 laa3
